name: map_sdk
_comment_app_assets: map_sdk's zone drawing page loads assets/lottie/pin.json (previously referenced but never installed by any SDK — broken at runtime). The copy comes from paas_driver develop (byte-identical to paas_manager's). app_assets registers it in the host pubspec's sdk-app-assets block so it is bundled.

customer._comment: Customer flavour (fix-wave 2026-09-02, route-map rows 16 and 21). Pre-fork paas_customer routed /map -> ViewMapPage and /map_search -> MapSearchPage from its host router; after the refork both pages live in this SDK's lib/ and auto_route never generates a class for an SDK-resident page, so base_sdk's AppRoutes.pushViewMapRoute (add_address, sellect_address_screen, marketplace address_list/create_shop, orders sender/recipient widgets) and pushMapSearchRoute (view_map_page's own search) hit _HostAppRoutes.noSuchMethod and the marketplace pushNamed('/map') sites found no route. The shell below is installed into the host so its build generates ViewMapRoute / MapSearchRoute; routes keep the pre-fork paths; app_routes fills the two seams (params copied verbatim from base_sdk app_routes.dart - dynamic-typed, so the bool args are defaulted in the body the way the page defaults them). Scoped to customer rather than top level because map_sdk is composed into driver/manager/pos too and those personas have no /map path today - declaring top level would change six profiles at once.

app_routes.params: BuildContext context, {dynamic address, dynamic indexAddress, dynamic isParcel, dynamic isPop, dynamic isShopLocation, dynamic shopId}
app_routes.body: context.router.push(ViewMapRoute(address: address, indexAddress: indexAddress, isParcel: isParcel ?? false, isPop: isPop ?? true, isShopLocation: isShopLocation ?? false, shopId: shopId));
